record.original_question: Is every contact Fano manifold homogeneous?

evidence.quote: It is easily seen that a homogeneous Fano contact manifold is of type b), so we can rephrase Conjecture 6 as : Conjecture 7. A contact Fano manifold is homogeneous.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A complex contact manifold is a connected complex projective manifold $X$ of odd complex dimension $2n+1$ equipped with a holomorphic line bundle $L$ and a holomorphic one-form $\theta \in H^0(X, \Omega^1_X \otimes L)$ such that $\theta \wedge (d\theta)^n \in H^0(X, K_X \otimes L^{n+1})$ is nowhere vanishing; equivalently, the kernel $D = \ker\theta \subset TX$ is a corank-one holomorphic distribution that is maximally non-integrable. Such an $X$ is called a contact Fano manifold if in addition its anticanonical bundle $-K_X$ is ample (so $X$ is a Fano manifold). A Fano manifold $X$ is called homogeneous if its automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ acts transitively on $X$; equivalently, $X = G/P$ for a complex semisimple Lie group $G$ and a parabolic subgroup $P$.

Prove or disprove: every contact Fano manifold is homogeneous. Equivalently, show that every Fano manifold admitting a holomorphic contact structure is biholomorphic to the closed orbit (adjoint variety) of the adjoint action of a complex simple Lie group on the projectivization of its Lie algebra.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (equivalent to the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture for positive quaternion-Kähler manifolds) remains open in general. Partial results include verification in low dimensions (contact Fano manifolds of dimension ≤9 admitting a Kähler–Einstein metric, equivalently positive quaternion-Kähler manifolds of real dimension ≤16) and under hypotheses of high-rank reductive automorphism groups (Buczyński–Wiśniewski–Weber and others, 2018–2021).

status_evidence.title: High rank torus actions on contact manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture (LeBrun–Salamon): every contact Fano manifold is homogeneous. Proven under high-rank torus action assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open in general; proved when automorphism group has sufficiently large rank.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic torus actions on contact manifolds (arXiv:1802.05002)
status_evidence.snippet: In the absence of a proof of the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture in its full generality, low-dimensional cases have been verified.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for contact Fano manifolds of dimension ≤9 with Kähler–Einstein metric.

status_evidence.title: Fano Manifolds, Contact Structures, and Quaternionic Geometry (LeBrun)
status_evidence.snippet: Original formulation conjecturing that every Fano contact manifold is homogeneous.
